newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines sees 4.7 pct farm sector growth in '97.
newsitem.headline: Philippines sees 4.7 pct farm sector growth in '97.

text.p: Philippine agricultural growth is expected to rise to 4.7 percent this year from last year's 3.9 percent due to prospects of better rice harvests, Agriculture Secretary Salvador Escudero said on Wednesday.
Escudero also told reporters unmilled rice production this year may hit 12.3 million tonnes from last year's 11.54 million with the installation of more irrigation facilities.
The government plans to put more money into irrigation facilities to increase output on some 400,000 hectares of rice land, he said.
Last year, some 1.2 million hectares was planted to rice, Escudero said.
